metadata.description: Heyra demo marketplace: four realistic Claude Code plugins that show every plugin component type - skills, subagents, hooks, MCP servers, LSP servers, output styles and evals.

plugins.name: nordlys-brand
plugins.description: Brand guidelines and marketing for Nordlys Analytics (fictional). Brand voice and palette skills, /linkedin-post, /campaign-brief, /brand-check, a brand-reviewer subagent, banned-word hooks, a bundled brand-assets MCP server, a marketing output style and an eval suite.

plugins.name: fabric-toolkit
plugins.description: Microsoft Fabric data engineering. Medallion architecture and PySpark notebook skills with code templates, Fabric CLI reference, /fabric-deploy, notebook-reviewer and fabric-deployer subagents, safety hooks for destructive fab commands, the Fabric Core MCP server with Azure CLI auth, and userConfig for workspace settings.

plugins.name: dbt-toolkit
plugins.description: dbt analytics engineering. Model conventions that load automatically for models/**, /dbt-new-model scaffolder, /dbt-test-coverage report, /dbt-build-fix in a forked subagent, dbt-runner and sql-reviewer subagents, production-guard and model-lint hooks, and the official dbt MCP server.

plugins.name: dev-toolkit
plugins.description: General coding productivity. /commit, /pr-description, /review-changes, /doctor and /setup skills, TDD guidance, code-reviewer and test-writer subagents, shell and prompt hooks (destructive-command guard, auto-format, session git context, stop-time test check), Python and TypeScript LSP servers, and Context7 plus Playwright MCP servers.
